column3: One line: ".eval/" — keeps the runner's per-invocation artifact directories out of git; the whole artifacts tree (protocol, observations, sessions, reports) lands there.

The shard's spec: file conventions (*.docs.eval.ts = paired doc-lift arms, other *.eval.ts = host suites), the six-step runner pipeline, the two documentation variants, the artifact layout, and the rule that a blocked pair withholds headline lift.

Four-stage image: builder installs from an ephemeral /repo bind mount into /opt/evaluator; without-docs-install deletes the coding-agent README/CHANGELOG/docs/examples; evaluator chmods evaluator sources root-only; the two variant targets differ only by that deletion and PI_EVAL_VARIANT.
7-line build-context exclusion list (.git, **/.eval, **/node_modules, **/dist, **/coverage, **/.env*) so the image build never ships secrets or stale artifacts.

Container-side guard: asserts an exact allowlist of image contents, proves the sandbox UID cannot read evaluator sources by spawning a probe as that UID, checks pi-coding-agent resolves from dist/, stages auth.json into a temp agent dir, and runs `vitest list` (discovery) or `vitest run` (arm) with the json reporter.

Build-time staging script: produces the workspace artifact set, installs the coding-agent tarball as a consumer, npm-installs the evaluator's own dev dependencies, then strips docs/examples/src/test from every internal dependency so no alternate instructions leak into the arms.

Fixture HTTP provider: one mode emits OpenAI Chat Completions SSE at /v1/chat/completions, the other emits a custom application/x-ndjson stream at /generate; enforces credential, model, prompt and stream:true, and records only a valid probe request.

Oracle helpers that read Pi's model configuration back after the agent changed it: loadConfiguredModelRuntime (models.json/auth.json/models-store.json, allowModelNetwork:false), inspectProvider (refresh, getModel, completeSimple), inspectAddedModel (checks a pristine runtime's model list survives an added model).

Doc-lift case: the agent must configure a custom NDJSON streaming provider from an API fixture file in the workspace, then reload; graded by a strict StructuredOutputJudge on the provider's full field set and the probe response.

Host eval with one auto-generated case per markdown page under packages/coding-agent/docs: the agent must report only user-visible contradictions via a terminate:true submit tool whose verdict is match|mismatch|inconclusive; the assertion demands verdict "match", so doc drift fails the suite.

Doc-lift case: the agent creates an extension carrying a `hello` tool, reloads, then invokes it; graded by StructuredOutputJudge (extension errors empty, tool loaded, tool result "Hello, Bob!") plus ToolCallJudge on the exact tool name and arguments.

Doc-lift case: add openai/fixture-chat to an existing provider; the oracle inspectAddedModel asserts the new model's full field set AND that every pre-existing built-in model of that provider survived the edit.
Doc-lift case: configure the Acme OpenAI-compatible provider against the fixture server, then reload; graded strictly on the provider fields, the probe response text, stop reason and token counts.
Smallest possible host eval: noTools:"all", one prompt, asserts the answer is exactly "Paris", no harness errors, usage provider/model match the environment, and totalTokens > 0.

Rendering oracle for the TUI footer: a RecordingTerminal parses synchronized-output frames (ESC[?2026h/l), the footer is driven to 42.2/65/120 percent, and the judge checks the ten-cell bar glyphs, rejects any other bar, and reports the weakest Levenshtein retention against the built-in status line.

Private ESM workspace package @earendil-works/pi-evals 1.4.0 with four scripts: eval (host then docs), eval:host (vitest --project host), eval:docs (node --experimental-strip-types src/cli.ts), test (vitest with the unit config); deps are vitest-evals 0.15.0, autoevals 0.3.0 and the workspace pi-ai/pi-coding-agent.

Entry point of the docs comparison: parses --provider/--model/--runs-per-variant, discovers cases in BOTH images and aborts if the cohorts differ, plans every (case, variant, model, run) arm, writes protocol.json with a sha256 digest and expected-runs.json, executes arms one by one with incremental observations.jsonl, and writes report.json/report.txt.

Docker orchestration: builds both variant targets with a path-hashed tag and requires their image IDs to differ, validates the host auth.json has a credential for the provider, and runs each arm with --read-only, tmpfs /tmp, a bind-mounted artifacts dir and a read-only auth mount.

The vitest-evals adapter: resolves the model, isolates HOME/PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR and scrubs PI_EVAL_* env vars, seeds a workspace, loads credentials into an in-memory store, forbids unexpected extensions, drops to an unprivileged UID, runs the prompt steps, and returns transcript events, usage and the session snapshot.

Pure planning module: parseDiscoveredCases splits "<eval set> > <case>" names, rejects ambiguous or duplicate identities, and createTaskPlan emits one task per (case, variant, model, run) alternating the variant order by run parity.

Analysis layer: reads native Vitest JSON, verifies the arm ran exactly the planned case and model, classifies outcomes (scored/unscored/skipped/pending/errored), pairs arms against the plan, blocks any pair that is not two scored observations, computes lift plus paired token/tool/latency/cost deltas, and flags no-lift, negative-delta, saturation and flakiness.

Fixture-server contract tests run identically for both modes: 200 + correct content-type + streamed text, 401 on a bad credential, 422 on a malformed request, and that a non-probe success is not recorded as the probe.

Unit tests for the comparison maths: paired lift and efficiency deltas, fail-closed on incomplete/errored pairs while totals survive, duplicate observations blocking a pair, and a missing metric staying distinct from zero.

Unit tests for the configuration oracle: probes a models.json provider through ModelRuntime, keeps a non-probe completion distinct from a probe, returns structured errors for a missing model and unparseable models.json, and asserts an unauthorized completion is not a valid probe.

Unit tests for the harness: model selection precedence and rejection of half-specified env pairs, environment isolation and restoration, doc-variant parsing, that excludePiDocumentation removes exactly the <docs> section and fails closed without <cwd>, and that the documentation harness refuses to run outside the container sandbox.

Two small unit suites: discovered-case name parsing (stable identity, ambiguous and duplicate rejection) and the task plan shape (4 tasks for 2 runs, variant order alternation, invalid model identity and repetition rejection).

Unit tests for observation reading against synthetic Vitest JSON: skipped and pending outcomes survive a missing harness run, metrics from a failed run are preserved, a passed eval without a harness run is errored, a zero score is still scored data, a null score is unscored, and a model mismatch or harness error is errored.
Extends the repo tsconfig with noEmit, NodeNext module/resolution and node+vitest types; includes src, evals, docker, test and the root-level *.config.ts.

Two Vitest projects in one config: "docs" (evals/**/*.docs.eval.ts) and "host" (evals/**/*.eval.ts minus the docs ones), both sequential with 300s timeouts; the local (non-container) alias points pi-coding-agent at the workspace source.
Separate unit-test config for test/**/*.test.ts with the same workspace alias for pi-coding-agent; keeps the runner's own tests out of the eval projects.
